node.statement: If ||W-V||<=K*delta, bilinearity and the product bound imply ||W^dagger bold-dot W-V^dagger bold-dot V||<= (1+epsilon_r)||W-V||(||W||+||V||). Since ||W||<=||V||+K*delta and V is uniformly bounded, this is at most C_K*delta. Hence ||W^dagger bold-dot W-J||<=2r+C_K*delta<=C_{c,K}delta and W is uniformly bounded. Repeating the associator calculation from the first child yields ||L_{W^dagger}L_W-I||<=C_{c,K}(epsilon_r+delta). The root guard makes this at most 1/4, and the argument of the second child gives invertibility of L_W and a uniform inverse bound.
